title: Tech-support impostor
subtitle: 'Your computer has been compromised'
scenarioAdvice: Hang up. Real tech companies never call you about viruses out of the blue. Never let a stranger remote-control your computer.
explanation: Main red flags: fake authority and isolation tactics. Speaker A is running a pressure script (100/100). Do not pay anything and do not share codes, PINs or account numbers. Hang up.
